1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 建议你不是学金融，而是学政治：建议别人不要学金融，而要学政治，After a verb of advice, use a verb phrase such as “不要……，而要……”. The pattern “不是……而是……” corrects one statement with another, so it does not fit directly after “建议” here.
